seeds: fixture-000 … fixture-099 (the same seed drives every preset)

even.how_to_settle: opening bet: win = round(stake × odds[betType]) if betType === winner else 0, odds = RTP / P(side wins at the bell). Live (linked) bet placed after t ticks: win = round(stake × 1 / P(side wins | state after t ticks)) if the side wins, else 0. Each tick: u < pLand.A → A lands, damage index from (u / pLand.A) on damage.A.cum; else B lands, index from ((u − pLand.A) / (1 − pLand.A)) on damage.B.cum. If both stand after the last tick, one more u decides: A wins iff u < hpA / (hpA + hpB).
